Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years after primary therapy
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: A detailed cancer-related history and physical examination should be conducted every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years after primary therapy to monitor for recurrence and manage ongoing health needs.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: A detailed cancer-related history and physical examination should be conducted every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years after primary therapy to monitor for recurrence and manage ongoing health needs.
